query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Nvidia on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: NVIDIA, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. Sources below are limited to the search results provided.

## Leadership and governance

- Jensen Huang resigned as chairman, CEO, and director, with immediate effect. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and remains CFO until a successor is chosen. The board is searching internally and externally. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- NVIDIA announced the CEO transition on 12 Nov 2026. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
- On 8 Nov, the board said it had "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team." (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)
- Huang admitted an affair. The board said it would investigate. The New York Times later reported a relationship with Kimberly Powell, NVIDIA's VP of health care, who reports to him. (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns)
- Wired reported that NVIDIA hired a crisis PR firm at least a year before Huang acknowledged the affair. The retrieved text was mostly page navigation, so only the headline is confirmed. (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-cbe54f11b05c0e59be5a05db_wired-_nvidia_hired)

## Launches and product

- At a 2026 event, NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 debuted in MLPerf Inference v6.1 results in September. Rubin reportedly moved into production shipments in H2 2026. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)
- NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion, dated 8 Nov. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)

## Deals and partnerships

- An AWS and NVIDIA announcement describes AWS deploying 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra, Rubin, and Rubin Ultra GPUs across 2027 and 2028. This is reported secondhand. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)
- A wire report dated 15 Nov says a company agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, with closing expected next quarter. The article does not name NVIDIA in the retrieved text, so NVIDIA's role is unconfirmed. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- Older acquisitions listed in a company profile, outside the 30-day window: Hugging Face (Aug 2026, $12.90B), Kumo.AI (Jun 2026, $400M), and Illumex (Feb 2026, $60M). (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t)

## Hires

- No new external hires were found in the results. Kress's interim appointment is the only leadership change confirmed. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)

## Scheduled events

- NVIDIA reports Q3 results around 4:20 p.m. ET on Tue 17 Nov, with an earnings call at 5 p.m. ET. It is the first call since Huang's exit. (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline)

## Open questions

1. With Kress as interim CEO and CFO, who now owns strategic and capital-allocation decisions, and what is the timeline for naming a permanent CEO?
2. Has the board's investigation concluded or changed the governance or disclosure approach, and how will it affect senior leadership relationships?
3. Does the Globex deal involve NVIDIA, and how do the Rubin ramp and the AWS 2027–2028 GPU commitment shape supply and pricing expectations after today's earnings?
